purpose: Executable workstream contract for PREVINE G040 hydrology-hydraulics research stack.

hec_sma_continuous.first_target: BHO6 branch architecture with 8 incremental intervals/11 components before any 145-unit transfer
hec_sma_continuous.later_target: 145 legacy HEC units only after native/reconstructed geometry-topology is independently verified
prohibited: derive SMA storages/percolation directly from SCS Curve Number without source/validation
copy event-calibrated CN/lag into SMA state parameters
start each forecast event from arbitrary dry/wet initial percentages
calibration_sequence: choose PET source and units/time basis
jointly refine peak/timing/rise/recession across calibration events

hindcast_warmup.method: prefer supplied potential evaporation as external PET first; retain component atmospheric variables for independent sensitivity/alternative ET methods
hindcast_warmup.purpose: historical warm-up, continuous state reconstruction, calibration and validation

near_real_time.requirement: fresh atmospheric forcing with timestamp/provenance; do not extend stale ERA5-Land values forward
candidate_methods: Hargreaves where only reliable temperature is available
near_real_time.preferred_rule: use the same documented method across replay and pseudo-operational evaluation before promotion

pet_strategy.hec_hms_rule: continuous SMA must not run with implicit zero PET

mgb.role: independent basin-scale hydrologic member, not a clone of HEC-HMS
mgb.discretization: derive MGB mini-basins/HRUs independently from hydrologically consistent terrain and land/soil inputs

soil: Embrapa 2011 soil map as coarse independent reference
land_cover: MapBiomas source data; alternate 166-unit workbook is evidence only, not a HEC145 crosswalk
precipitation: G040 observed full-grid for contemporary replay
CHIRPS archive for independent historical comparison where resolution is suitable
dem: project MDE archive; hydrologically consistent DEM not yet selected
historical_meteorology: ERA5-Land hourly temperature/dewpoint/surface pressure/10m wind/solar radiation variables for hindcast preprocessing
historical_land_state: ERA5-Land volumetric soil water layers as independent state diagnostic/assimilation research input, not direct MGB parameter replacement

mgb.comparison_policy: same benchmark events/checkpoints/metrics as HEC; no winner chosen on NSE alone

terrain: LiDAR/terrain assets already used in Santa Tereza and Muçum project products
structures: bridges/culverts/levees from field/GIS inventory when available

assimilation.stage_1: documented deterministic state/boundary update at fresh observed controls
assimilation.stage_2: sequential/ensemble assimilation research after Stage-1 replay is validated
assimilation.forbidden: visual curve translation presented as physical state assimilation

uncertainty_next: ECMWF ensemble forcing when exact member/cycle provenance is available

impact.interface_policy: observation, forecast and scenario must be visually and semantically distinct
impact.operational_gate: independent validation + local procedure/governance; decision support does not replace official civil-defense warning

no_leakage_rule: Do not move validation/holdout events into calibration after inspecting results.
